He is known for his unwavering love for God and his psalms, many of which are still sung in Christian churches today. The spiritual significance of the name "Dav(id)" lies in its association with faith, strength, and God's love. Additionally, the name "David" represents the idea that our faith and connection with God can help us overcome seemingly insurmountable challenges, just as David did when he defeated Goliath.
